title: EU-Wide Analytics-as-a-Service Launch
description: TechForward wants to launch a new analytics module within its existing ERP platform. The module aggregates and analyzes customer business data (including employee performance metrics and financial KPIs) to provide benchmarking insights across the customer base. Data is processed in TechForward's Frankfurt data center. Target: all existing EU customers.
executive_question: Can we launch this in all 6 markets by June 15?

title: AI-Powered Financial Risk Scoring for Banking Clients
description: TechForward plans to build an AI module that uses machine learning to score credit risk for banking customers. The system would ingest customer financial data, apply predictive models, and output risk scores that banks use in lending decisions. Training data comes from anonymized historical banking data. The product would be offered to banks across the EU, with initial focus on Germany and the Netherlands.

product_characteristics.automated_decision_impact: Decisions significantly affect access to credit and financial services

executive_question: What are the deal breakers for launching this by September? What's the minimum viable compliance?

title: ESG Reporting Dashboard for Mid-Market Clients
description: TechForward wants to add an ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance) reporting module to its ERP platform. The module would help mid-market companies collect, calculate, and report on their sustainability metrics in compliance with the EU Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD). No AI involved — it's a data collection and reporting tool. The product is for EU-based companies with 250+ employees.
executive_question: This seems low-risk from a regulatory perspective — confirm that and tell me if there are any surprises.

title: Cross-Border HR Analytics Platform with US Expansion
description: TechForward plans to expand its HR analytics module to US-based customers. The module processes employee data (performance reviews, compensation, diversity metrics, attrition predictions) using AI-driven analytics. Data from US employees would be processed in TechForward's Frankfurt data center, requiring transatlantic data transfers. The product would also be sold to existing EU customers.

product_characteristics.ai_type: machine learning — predictive analytics and clustering
product_characteristics.data_transfer_details: US employee data transferred to EU (Frankfurt) for processing; results returned to US clients

executive_question: Is this even feasible by August? What's the biggest regulatory risk that could kill this project?
